what: CODE-GRAPH P4 acceptance: manual check of 30 deadcode candidates, false-positive share published
method: simple random sample (seed 27) of the 120 dead candidates over 8 application repositories; an independent validator agent that did not write the detector read every definition and searched each repository for the name in every file type (case-sensitive whole word, rg -uu), with a negative and a positive control
findings_acted_on: USED case: the call lives in a Python block inside a Markdown skill -- another file type, outside the graph; stated in the deadcode note
two DEAD functions were imported by name and never called: the answer now lists imported_by, so the import goes with the function
